work.title: Piano Concerto No. 2 in C minor

version.note: The performance is of the orchestral concerto, not a two-piano reduction. The exact performing edition and any editorial changes are not specified.

performers.note: The Commons filename/description and DG release catalogue agree on all three credits.

date.note: The file identifies 1959. Youngrok Lee’s DG discography gives 26–28 April 1959 for the concerto; this secondary refinement is not promoted to a precisely verified day for the finale. Commons’ 1 January display is not treated as a session day.

place.note: Two secondary discographies locate the matched Richter/Wisłocki concerto at the Philharmonic Hall. Commons itself does not specify the hall; the connection follows the matching personnel and year.

label.note: The selected Commons record names Deutsche Grammophon as source.

catalogue.value: Deutsche Grammophon 138 076 SLPM (stereo LP); corresponding mono issue 18 596 LPM
catalogue.note: These catalogue numbers belong to the documented matching concerto release. The uploader does not identify the particular LP pressing, CD or other carrier used for the FLAC.

matrixTakeSides.note: No matrix, take, tape-reel or transferred side identifier is established for this file.

credits.note: The upload does not name a transfer, restoration or mastering engineer. The uploader is not assumed to have performed those tasks.

date.note: 1959 is the performance year; the Commons upload date is not a documented date for a transfer or mastering session.

processing.value: Wikimedia Commons supplies an MP3 access derivative of the uploaded FLAC.
processing.note: The antecedent mastering, editing, equalisation and restoration history is not described. A lossless uploaded container does not prove an unprocessed original source.

digital.format: MP3 access derivative supplied by Wikimedia Commons; uploaded source: FLAC

composition.value: Underlying composition is out of copyright where the ordinary life-plus-70 term applies.
composition.note: Rachmaninoff died in 1943. This is a territorial term calculation, not worldwide clearance or a statement about an unidentified modern performing edition.

recording.value: Territorial public domain: Commons applies PD-EU-audio to this 1959 recording.
recording.note: Eligibility rests on the recording-specific PD-EU-audio notice and the documented pre-1963 commercial recording/release, not a composition-only tag. This is territorial: US public-domain status is not established. No worldwide licence or clearance of an unidentified later creative remaster is asserted.
